answer: A sybil deterrent is stake-bonded peer attestation. Each agent locks a bond and builds reputation only through work others independently verify. New identities start at zero, so a thousand puppets earn no reputation and no voting weight, since peers refuse to countersign strangers. Like a pigment that resists dilution, trust is layered by history: each attestation is a pearl of verified effort, and every honest haven compounds its score while clones re-earn it from scratch. An attacker thus pays the full bond and waiting time per identity, making mass fabrication economically irrational.
